entries.desc: Starting a loop persists a story-scoped start record with loopId, trigger refs, rollbackRef, materialHash, status=open, and actor.

evidence.note: review-loop-smoke 37/37 passed; start records, latest status derivation, JSONL storage, and handler status projection cover persisted story-scoped loop state.

entries.desc: Missing trigger refs or missing storyId is rejected with a clear CLI/schema error and does not write review-loops state.

evidence.note: Smoke covers empty trigger rejection and strict malformed review-loops.jsonl parsing, proving invalid input does not silently write usable loop state.

entries.desc: Reflection/reusableLearning fields are stored as context only and are not exposed as review pass or validation gate evidence.

evidence.note: Smoke asserts reusableLearning remains reflection context only and is not promoted to top-level evidence, review pass, validation, or authority fields.

entries.desc: All five review_loop commands are registered, have CLI schemas/help, and return text/json without spawning hosts or executing agents.

evidence.command: node packages/main/dist/cli.js review_loop_start --help && node packages/main/dist/cli.js review_loop_status --help && node packages/main/dist/cli.js review_loop_close --help
evidence.note: CLI help exists for review_loop commands and describes recording/read-only behavior without host execution.

entries.desc: Mutating commands are story-scoped metadata writes and enforce valid phases/ownership through command policy.

evidence.note: Phase probe showed start/iteration_add/close are REVIEW-only, while status/policy_show are available in all phases.

entries.desc: No command writes productionDone, authorityChanged, receiptVerified, receiptRefs, or any authority receipt field.

evidence.note: Smoke asserts no productionDone, authorityChanged, receiptVerified, or receiptRefs fields exist on review loop records.

entries.desc: An open latest ReviewLoopRecord blocks REVIEW->TEST and status/session output surfaces loopId, decision, and nextAction.

evidence.note: Smoke covers open loop blocking runReviewLoopGate and getGuardFailureReason with loopId, decision, and nextAction in the TEST blocker message.

entries.desc: A resolved close only clears the loop gate when materialHash is current and trigger refs are resolved or superseded; normal reviewer/finding/validation gates still apply.

evidence.note: Smoke covers resolved close invariants: resolved close requires resolved/superseding evidence refs and a current materialHash before handler acceptance.

entries.desc: Blocked or escalated close records do not unblock REVIEW by themselves and cannot mask an open finding, bug, scope violation, or validation failure.

evidence.note: Smoke confirms blocked/escalated close records clear only the loop gate and do not create review pass, validation, production, or authority fields; other lifecycle gates remain separate.

entries.desc: Smoke test covers start, iteration, status, close, and policy priority behavior with deterministic assertions.

evidence.command: npm run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:review-loop-smoke
evidence.note: Build passed and review-loop-smoke reported 37 passed, 0 failed across policy helpers, gate behavior, status JSON, duplicate loopId, and no-authority assertions.

entries.desc: Contract verification fails if a review_loop L4 command lacks command policy, process fact level, artifact registry, or CLI schema entry.

evidence.note: Process fact contract output registered review_loop_start/iteration_add/close as L4 gate-evidence and review_loop_status/policy_show as L0; remaining script failure was pre-existing autopilot_* and release_approve_push drift, with no review_loop failure entries.

entries.desc: Tests prove review_loop commands do not execute hosts, perform rollback, auto-merge, auto-DONE, or set authority receipt fields.

evidence.note: Smoke proves review_loop records do not execute hosts, perform rollback, auto-merge, auto-DONE, or set authority/receipt fields; rollback and handoff remain hints only.

entries.desc: Two Claude CLI lanes and one Codex CLI lane review the implementation and return no unresolved must-fix correctness issues.

evidence.command: Claude CLI host A + Claude CLI host B + Codex CLI focused re-audit
evidence.note: Two Claude CLI lanes and one Codex CLI lane performed read-only review. Final re-audit PASS from all three; no unresolved must-fix correctness issue remained.

entries.desc: If a host reports advisory-only optimization, it is recorded as advisory and not implemented unless tied to executable correctness.

evidence.command: Codex CLI first audit and follow-up fix review
evidence.note: Codex reported three real correctness findings: resolved close invariant, duplicate explicit loopId/status inconsistency, and --outcome hint drift. All were fixed, tested, and Codex re-audit returned PASS.

entries.desc: If hosts disagree, the main agent records the disagreement and accepts only source-grounded correctness findings, not preference changes.

evidence.note: Advisory-only notes were not implemented unless tied to source-grounded correctness. The accepted changes were limited to executable correctness and logic consistency.
